title: Florida attorney general "demands" the NFL suspend the Rooney Rule

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Florida attorney general "demands" the NFL suspend the Rooney Rule
sources.description: Last month, former NFL Players Association executive director DeMaurice Smith explained in a visit to PFT Live at the Super Bowl that accountability when it comes to the league's hiring practices could come from the attorneys general of one or more states in which the NFL does business.
